research_question: Does eligibility for the fictional 'Coral Grant' (awarded when a school's invented readiness score is at least 70) increase graduation rates?
data_description: Cross-section of 1,500 invented schools. Variables: school_id, readiness_score (0-100), grant (1 = received), grad_rate.
institutional_context: In this made-up programme the 70-point cutoff was fixed before scores were collected.
